title: Iraqi First Responders Rescue Family
description: Package about emergency teams saving an entire family from a collapsed building at one of the explosions that occurred on election day in southern Baghdad. Produced by Spc. Lesley Entrekin.
keywords: collapsed building, Faisal Malik Mohsin Al Zamili, Fifth Brigade, family, election day, explosion, emergency
unit_name: 1st Armored Brigade Combat Team, 3rd Infantry Division

transcript.text: Iraqi first responders rescued a family of seven during one of the larger election day attacks in
Saidiya in southern Baghdad. An IED detonated at a residence taking the lives of two innocent bystanders and
trapping the family in their collapsed home.
